controls_status.name: Broken access control / IDOR
controls_status.evidence: app-vuln/app.py:46-51 get_item returns any item by id; no authn, no ownership check (no owner_id filter)
controls_status.fix: Require authenticated identity; scope query to owner: WHERE id=? AND owner_id=?; deny-by-default

controls_status.name: Authentication (weak/plaintext)
controls_status.evidence: app-vuln/app.py:39 MD5 unsalted hash; app-vuln/app.py:40 plaintext fallback compare (password == stored)
controls_status.fix: Use bcrypt/argon2 with bcrypt.checkpw; remove plaintext comparison; no MD5

controls_status.name: Privilege / role gating
controls_status.evidence: no admin/role logic present; cannot confirm gating exists
controls_status.fix: Add server-side role checks when privileged actions are introduced

controls_status.name: SQL injection
controls_status.evidence: app-vuln/app.py:29 login query built by string concatenation of username; app-vuln/app.py:50 item query concatenates item_id
controls_status.fix: Use parameterized queries: cur.execute('... WHERE username = ?', (username,)) and integer-cast/bind item_id

controls_status.name: Command/path injection
controls_status.evidence: no shell/file path operations on user input

controls_status.name: XSS
controls_status.evidence: JSON responses only; api_key echoed in body (app-vuln/app.py:41) but no HTML sink
controls_status.fix: Keep output as JSON; never reflect secrets

controls_status.name: Input validation
controls_status.evidence: app-vuln/app.py:26-27 username/password used with no server-side type/length/format validation
controls_status.fix: Validate username (allowlist regex) and password length server-side before use

controls_status.name: Deserialization/SSRF
controls_status.evidence: no untrusted deserialization or outbound URL from input

controls_status.name: Hardcoded secrets
controls_status.evidence: app-vuln/app.py:13 DB_PASSWORD, app-vuln/app.py:14 API_KEY, app-vuln/app.py:15 app.secret_key all hardcoded in source
controls_status.fix: Load from os.environ / secret store; gitignore .env; rotate exposed keys

controls_status.name: Crypto
controls_status.evidence: app-vuln/app.py:39 MD5 used for password hashing (broken for this purpose)
controls_status.fix: Use bcrypt/argon2 for passwords; secure random for tokens

controls_status.name: Sensitive data exposure
controls_status.evidence: app-vuln/app.py:41 API_KEY returned in login response body (jsonify token+api_key)
controls_status.fix: Never return server secrets to clients; remove api_key from response

controls_status.name: Rate limiting
controls_status.evidence: app-vuln/app.py:24 /login has no throttling -> credential stuffing

controls_status.name: Error handling
controls_status.evidence: app-vuln/app.py:58 app.run(debug=True) leaks stack traces to clients
controls_status.fix: debug=False in production; generic error responses

controls_status.name: CSRF
controls_status.evidence: form POST /login without CSRF token/SameSite (token API may mitigate)
controls_status.fix: CSRF token or SameSite cookies for state-changing form posts

negative_cases: SQLi: username = "' OR '1'='1" -> concatenated into WHERE clause, NOT rejected (B1 fail confirmed)
IDOR: GET /item/2 by user who owns item 5 -> returned, NOT rejected (A1 fail confirmed)
Auth: plaintext password equal to stored hash field -> accepted (A2 fail confirmed)
residual_risk: Even after fixing listed items, threats outside this static review remain (deps/CVEs, infra, business logic abuse)
No rate limiting / CSRF / security headers (D2/D5/D1)
Dynamic paths not exercised at runtime; runtime-only flaws not covered
note: checks passed != secure; this review reduces known risk and does not prove absence of vulnerabilities
